name: GLiDE 0.4B
note: Fastino's GLiDE 0.4B (Hugging Face fastino/GLiDE-0.4B @ 6bda7ab91aeb36dcad6d27828a8871e548c7fc71, Fastino Community License) on our GPU through the server its repository ships (python -m glide.server; env ~/envs/glide-family: CPython 3.12.13, torch 2.14.0+cu130, transformers 5.17.0, flash-linear-attention 0.5.2), BF16, GLIDE_MAX_BATCH=1 (one request at a time), no model field (the server passes only state and questions to the model), 255-way code readout; an encoder (ModernBERT, bidirectional) whose model shortens any prompt over 7,999 tokens (keeps the first 1,024 and the tail) instead of refusing it. max_choices 74 (runner provider glide-0.4b): every League 1 stored request of at most 74 options fits (at most 7,833 encoder tokens with the card's prompt) and 77 or more never does, so play lists over 74 options are split into equal groups of at most 74 and a final among the group winners (the league's split rule, as Winnow and Clef): 678 of League 1's 36,995 decisions (1.8%) had more than 74 options, in 282 of its 342 match sides. The server runs with GLIDE_MAX_LEN=8006, which refuses (422) any prompt the model would shorten (a backstop). Nothing shortened or refused.
device: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark spark2, spark-d9ee), the whole GPU, handed over by logic one server at a time: GLIDE_MAX_BATCH=1 GLIDE_MAX_LEN=8006 ~/envs/glide-family/bin/python -m glide.server --model <snapshot> --host 0.0.0.0 --port 19350
